messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Service degradation detected — increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate across us-east-1. p95 latency rising, errors ~= 18% over last 5m. Paging oncall.
oncall-sre-jordan: I’m on it. pulling up traces now. any smoking logs? @samir.ops can you double-check autoscaler health?
maria.cs: Heads-up: Stellarsource reported sporadic failures from their staging batch job 3m ago. They’re a Dedicated customer in us-east-1. cc @cs-liaison
samir.ops: Autoscaler showing some thrash on gpu-pool-3, nodes flapping due to OOM on a small subset of pods. I’ll pin that pool to current size and disable scale-up.
elena-prod: Rolling a temporary fallback: route Stellarsource to their EU dedicated pool (eu-west-1) for reads only. Will update routing policy in 2m. :arrow_right:
oncall-sre-jordan: Mitigation plan: 1) Pin autoscaler 2) Toggle routing for affected accounts 3) Enable token-based rate-limit at 60r/s for bulk jobs 4) Re-deploy model variant with smaller batch window. Executing step 1 now.
statusbot: Status page draft ready for review. Suggested severity: Major outage — Partial service disruption for some enterprise customers in us-east-1.
maria.cs: Draft customer notice for Stellarsource:

```Hi Leah,
We're investigating intermittent failures for generation requests originating in us-east-1. Our engineers are applying mitigations and routing your traffic to eu-west-1 as a temporary measure. Expected impact: increased latency for some requests and possible short-term rate limiting. We'll update within 30 minutes or as we have more info.
— Maria, Redwood CS
```

Can we make this slightly more specific about routing and ETA? They asked for ETA.
cs-liaison: Suggest adding: "Estimated restoration of normal routing: 45–90 minutes, pending verification of autoscaler and model roll forward." Keep it conservative.
samir.ops: Routing change applied for Stellarsource (customer_id: ss-7821). Verified sessions now hitting eu-west-1 nodes. Will monitor token error rate and QPS.
oncall-sre-jordan: Observed immediate drop in 5xx from 18% -> 6% for their traffic. Cluster memory pressure still elevated. Starting canary of recompiled model (smaller KV cache usage) to remaining nodes.
elena-prod: Can someone push the status page snippet? statusbot, paste below and publish as "partial service disruption" with the affected customers list.
statusbot: Status page snippet (ready):

```We are currently investigating partial disruptions impacting generation requests for select enterprise customers in the US-East region. Affected customers are being routed to alternate capacity in EU-West while we apply targeted mitigations. Impact: intermittent 5xx responses and elevated latency. Next update: in 30 minutes.
Affected customers (proactive routing): Stellarsource (ss-7821), Meridian Autos (ma-441), and Valence Systems (vs-119).
```

Publish? :white_check_mark:
maria.cs: Please do NOT include customer emails on public status page. Keep account names/IDs only. Confirmed.
cs-liaison: Sending tailored email to Stellarsource now (using the draft). cc: leah@stellarsource.com, infra-ops@stellarsource.com. I’ll paste the outgoing note here when sent.
cs-liaison: Sent to Stellarsource:

"Leah — we rerouted your traffic to eu-west-1. You may see slightly higher latency. We're monitoring and will update as we verify stability. Contact: cs@redwood.com if you have issues."

They responded: "Thanks — seeing some success, still a few failures at ~2%" — per DM from Leah.
oncall-sre-jordan: Good improvement. Leaving mitigation open until cluster memory normalized. Plan to roll back routing after 60m of stable metrics.
samir.ops: Noted a noisy job pattern from their staging pipeline causing bursts. Reached out to Stellarsource ops to suggest backoff configuration. They acknowledged.
elena-prod: Internal comm template for post-incident summary (for ops+eng):

"Summary: Partial generation degradation in us-east-1 caused by memory pressure and noisy bulk jobs from select enterprise tenants. Mitigations: pinned autoscaler, routed affected tenants to eu-west-1, deployed smaller-batch model variant, applied rate-limits. Impact: transient 5xx, elevated latency. Next steps: permanent autoscaler fix, tenant throttling policy, post-incident runbook update."

Anyone object to this wording?
maria.cs: LGTM. Add a line: "Customer outreach: immediate proactive notice sent; CS on standby for higher-touch comms."
oncall-sre-jordan: Final note: keeping oncall until metrics stable for 60m. If anyone wants to join the war room, ping me (DM). :phone:
cs-liaison: Adding this to the customer-impact tracker now. Will escalate to account exec if anything regresses.
statusbot: Published status: Partial service disruption — affected tenants listed. Next update scheduled at 3509876743 (in 10m).
